[b]June 12, 2028: A great resolve[/b]

The Framwyckke Theater in the city of Vysjllá filled with applause as the last words of the first draft of the petition of grievances was read aloud, or as it had begun to be called The Declaration of Union.

James Mjrkanlwyth peered from the stage of the theater as the clapping and cane tapping continued, attendance had risen dramatically to 143 people since the June 9th decision, with the duc of Knygta and Deyn wholeheartedly backing the effort.

A genius document, Mr. Lambeau, intoned the president as Lambeau stared out into the crowd.

Did you hear, our delegation to Montfleur has apparently turned heads in their legislature, Lambeau replied.

Really? That explains all the Montfleurois that I saw tonight, I heard that several travelled from Montfleur to be here, replied the president.

As the clapping and shouts began to dissipate, Lambeau stepped up to the podium, the papers on which his speech that night had been written, wrinkled from his fidgeting that night.

Fellow compatriots from near and far, 
I come before you tonight as a man convicted by the spirit of freedom, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of unity. 

For fifty years the legislature and government of Rosenmarkke has impeded and intruded upon the rights of the citizens, the regions, and the world, conducting upon itself a great affliction. 

For fifty years we have been beaten black and blue by ideology and propaganda, and for fifty years we bore the bruises and beatings with a serene and solemn duty. 

However, the failures of this government as of recent and the opening of the wounds by the Wuloosyan and Hochdeutsche forces, have shown us that the propaganda of unity is false, and the state does not stand united.

It is thus that I declare that I have a great resolve, a resolve that we will be united with our motherland, a resolve that freedom will be restored, a resolve that the people will once again have a voice to share to the world. 

Hear our cry o world, hear the roar of these masses, arise in indignation and fury, arise in speed and in ferocity. For Rosenmarkke shall not be silent, she shall not be tread upon.

It is thus that I, I have a great resolvethank you.
//-

[b]Wuloosya's "Empire"[/b]

"It would be well for us to expand our nation far beyond our current borders, for not only are the economic resources of Erene vast, but we are quickly running out of suitable territories for our republic, blessed by god to expand into."
-William Ashcroft, 15th President of the United Commonwealth

[b]Malaguetta Territory (1911)[/b]

In the year 1910, Wuloosya held a new constitutional convention to finally follow the rest of erene in the abolition of the institution of slavery. However an issue arose, Wuloosya is, inherently a human supremacist nation, if xenos and non elesyeran people were not in bondage, what would become of these freedmen. Two schools of thought arose during these convention debates, the first school of thought was the Apartheid or "Apartness" thought, which believed that xenos could, and ideally should be allowed to remain within Wuloosya itself, although in a manor that would make it clear that they were below the status of humans, second class citizens at best, this meant segregated schools, businesses, seating on public transport, housing, the inability to vote, etc. And Outsendin, or "Removal" Thought. Subscribers to the Outsendin theory believed that Wuloosya could only continue its existence as an ethnically homogenous states, and therefore that the freed men should be removed from the Wuloosyan mainland, either sent to countries who would take in these men or sent to Wuloosya's various colonial possessions around erene. Apartheid  thought would ultimately win, however President Samuel Norwood was a firm advocate of Outsendin, and refused to approve the new constitution if Congress did not approve of a limited venture into its utility. And thus congress approved funding for the National Freedmen's Resettlement Organization, freed xenos would either willingly or by coercion opt into this program, and then be sent to Wuloosya's territory for settlement. However, it became increasingly evident that already existing human settlers hated this sudden influx of xenos and the program was halted.

Not deterred by the initial failure of the program, Norwood would order the Wuloosyan Navy to begin scouting out new territory of the coast of Armor & Crown Islands, it would be discovered that the land adjacent to the coast of these islands was not controlled by any major power or nationstate, but rather a confederation of xeno polities, and was rich in iron and copper, a resource Wuloosya was needing as its admittially late industrial revolution was beginning. A mission to send xeno settlers to the land supported by marines was approved, the land would be named Malaguetta, a brukalish saying for "civilized land". Throughout the next decade over 150,000 xenos would be deported to the Malaguetta coast as these xenos then expanded inland, the native xeno population, who initially thought that the Wuloosyan xenos would join them and ousting their oppressors would find themselves oppressed by xeno and human settlers, with xeno settlers from Wuloosya implementing there own form of Apartheid in Malaguetta against the native xeno population and committing a series of massacres against them as they aggressively expanded inwards, expansion of Malaguetta would officially end in 1950 with the passage of the Malaguetta Act of 1953 which formalized its status as a Unincorporated, Organized Territory of Wuloosya. 

By the modern day, Malaguetta is the poorest Wuloosyan territory, with an abysmal GDP per Capita $1,212.12. Its primary industries are mineral extraction and the exploitation of the vast oil reserves off the coast, ironically however its one of the freest territories within Wuloosya for xenos, with xenos of Outsendin heritage being typically the richest and elite of the territory.

[b]The Alolan Territory (1892)[/b]

Wulosoyan business on the Alolan Island began in 1883 with the passing of the Wuloosyan-Alolan Friendship Treaty under the William Ashcroft administration. Ostensibly, the treaty was to deepen the trade ties between the Alolan Kingdom, which provided valuable port for Wuloosyan Sugar traders up and down the argos coast, the existence of Pokemon on alola, which was initially considered a solely Wuloosyan phenomenon provided an interesting opportunity for Wuloosyan researchers to learn more about the phenonomon, the ports of Melemele and the land around them were leased to Wuloosya for a collective period of 50 years. And lastly, Alola was perfectly willing to facilitate the smuggling of slaves to Wuloosya, desperately needed to continue its failing slave dependent economic system. However, the intentions of William Ashcroft were less pure than the treaty his Secretary of State negotiated with the Alolan Queen. While the treaty superficially protected alola from other powers through a wuloosyan garrison and naval station, these bases were little more than a ploy for what was to come, Wuloosyan settlers would arrive on the islands, with slavery still legal in the Kingdom, they brought the institution with them and began setting up vast sugar plantations. These settlers brought with them further Wuloosyan investment to the islands and further dependence, these settlers would also begin to form their own communities on the islands, especially near the Wuloosyan naval stationed and in the leased port city of Melemele. Ashcroft initially intended that these settlers and trade dependence on Wuloosya would force them into a vassalage-like state without necessarily having to directly administrate the islands.

However the death of Queen Akela, and her subsequent replacement by King Kaihe, and Ashcroft loss of the 1891 election would change this, incoming Henry Dalton had a different vision for the islands, he was a subscriber to the more chauvinistic and racist colonial vision that the Shamatine, Argosian, and Kinzaouic people where incapable of governing themselves, and their administration should fall to the thusly superior elesyeran and vespurian people, and thus began preparations for an invasion of the islands, all he needed was an excuse, and unfortunately for the Alolan Kingdom, that excuse would come with King Kaihe. Kaihe was a staunch abolitionist, and had been horrified by the spread of slavery onto the islands brought on by near unrestricted immigration of Wuloosyans. On March 11th, 1892 he issued a royal proclamation eliminating the institution and voiding the friendship treaty, unknowingly to the King, preparations had already been made for this exact scenario, 100 Wuloosyan Marines, supported by 1,000 men of the newly organized "Melemele Rifles" a paramilitary force marched on the Alolan capital of Hau'oli, seizing the royal palace and ousting the monarchy, these Melemele Rifles then took full control of the country and government, declaring the "Republic of Alola" which then immediately reversed the ban on slavery, and in a move that had been planned from the beginning of the Dalton presidency hurriedly requested annexation by Wuloosya. The senate approved the Wuloosyan-Alolan Annexation Agreement within the following month as the country fell under the control of Wuloosya.

In 1992 the Senate would later issue the apology resolution, which stated that the "Alolan Kingdom had been illegitimately overthrown by agents of the Wuloosyan State in a manner that was irreconcilable with international law and practice, and that legally speaking, the native alolan people never surrendered there sovereignty to the Wuloosyan State." However no effort towards independence would be made, with statehood being the ultimate goal of the most activists on the island, which the senate laid out its support for at the time in said resolution. More modern efforts towards this goal have made great strides, and Alolan Statehood is considered inevitable by most Wuloosyans.

[b]New Calvera and Montea Island Territories (1945)[/b]

New Calvera and Montea Island are unique in the fact that they are the only territories that Wuloosya currently possess that were directly taken from another nation during an officially declared war. This was of course during the Second World War. In 1944 after the sinking of the 36,000 ton superliner SS Chesapikdem, which resulted in 2,329 deaths by a Fleischian submarine whose captain had mistaken the ship for a Vespurian liner currently operating as a troop transport. Wuloosya joined the Second World War on the side of the allied powers, with Fleischia being directly declared war upon by congress. George Harland, who was president at the time ordered the Department of War to begin to make plans to send Wuloosyan troops abroad to support the allies, apart of this included an independent campaign against Wuloosya's long time rival of Hebasviriil and Floueschia. The Wuloosyan Navy and Marine corps made plans to land on New Calvera and Montea Islands, the Wuloosyan navy advanced into the Chiamor Sea, where they caught the Fleischian naval garrison protecting the islands off guard, and leaving them completely blocked in and forcing them to retreat deeper and deeper into the bay as they continued to suffer horrific losses until the Fleischian fleet surrendered, with the surrender of the fleet. The Governor-General of Montea surrendered to the Wuloosyan navy and marines moved peacefully onto the island to ensure its quick occupation, however New Calvera would be far more resistant. The landings at New Calvera would be the second largest military operation ever conducted by Wuloosya at that point and resulted in 5,000 deaths for the Wuloosyan Marine Corps. After the war, the International Alliance granted the islands to Wuloosya as a "trust territory" although Wuloosya quickly, and rather illegally, annexed the islands in 1949.

In the modern day, Montea Island is primarily inhabited by Wuloosyan settlers who moved there, and has become a popular retirement and tourist spot in the country, with Wooseny Park being a major source of employment on the island. New Calavera has retained much of its original Fleischian population, and like Malaguetta is extremely poor and the economy of the island is almost entirely dependent on resource exportation and manufacturing. Montes and New Calavera like alola are popular candidates for statehood in online and political circles due to their relatively large human populations. Pokemon have been imported to the islands and have quickly become the dominant wildlife.

[b]Cavendry, Bookerman, Armor & Crown Island Territories (1834-1889) [/b]

These collections of territories almost all have the same origin point. In 1834 Charles Fenwick, 7th President of Wuloosya signed the Island Act, which empowered Wuloosyan sailors to claim any and all islands they discovered for Wuloosya, and so long as these islands weren't already claimed by an existing power, the claimant would be awarded 50,000 Dollars from the Federal Government. The first of these islands were the Armor & Crown Island in 1834, followed by the Cavendry islands in 1850, and lastly the Bookerman islands 1889. These islands all had varying degrees of settlement. In the modern day these territories are usually almost solely used for offshore resource extraction and army bases, extending the reach of the WDF beyond Wuloosya's border.
